newsitem.title: JAPAN: Excessive weak, strong yen undesirable--Japan MOF.
newsitem.headline: Excessive weak, strong yen undesirable--Japan MOF.

text.p: An excessively weak or strong yen is undesirable, Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Wednesday.
He also said stable foreign exchange rates were important for Japan's economy.
"An excessive weakening as well as strengthening of the yen is undesirable. Stable currency rates are important for the management of our economy," Mitsuzuka said.

Asked whether he considered the yen's current exchange rate as being too weak, Mitsuzuka said he would not comment on specific rates, but added: "We will watch the effect of excessive yen weakness and take appropriate measures."
The dollar hit a four-year high against the yen of 122.86 yen on Wednesday morning.
